title.narrative: Feasibility market study for expanding e-commerce platform in secondary cities in Colombia

description.narrative:
Logysto is a technology-enabled e-commerce logistics platform established in 2017, that is currently operating in major Colombian cities such as Bogotá, Medellin, and Cali. Logysto is the brand name of Grupo Arlo. At the time of application. Grupo Arlo is 100% owned by Logysto Ltd, a company registered in the Cayman Islands. Grupo Arlo S.A.S has 51 direct employees.
Logysto simplifies e-commerce logistics with the use of technology (mobile technology and AI), combining it with the shared economy, making logistics for e-commerce retailers faster, cost-effective, and more reliable than traditional courier alternatives. Today, the company has more than 800 active delivery drivers that distribute more than 100K packages per month.The project encompasses a 12-month feasibility study to analyze the market and business conditions necessary for the setup of Vueltap’s business in the most appropriate secondary and tertiary cities, such as Barranquilla, Bucaramanga, Pereira, and Manizales cities among others.The purpose of the feasibility study is to understand the business opportunities and requirements in order to roll-out last-mile logistics solutions in smaller cities in Colombia such as Barranquilla, Bucaramanga, Pereira, and Manizales cities among others.
